convert-jeffresc report
=======================

Every converted object adopts the group JeffResc created (managementPolicy: Adopt).
Adoption writes only the fields in the spec: a field JeffResc left unset is left unset
here, so the live value stays.
Before turning dryRun off, read each object's Ready condition (reason AdoptionDryRun lists
`field: old -> new`) and edit the spec until the only listed changes are ones you intend.

AuthentikGroup media/media-admins
  files: authentikgroup-media-admins.yaml
  notes:
    - members are not managed: JeffResc never managed membership, so spec.members is absent

AuthentikGroup media/media-users
  files: authentikgroup-media-users.yaml
  notes:
    - attribute "goauthentik.io/x" is reserved for Authentik or this operator; left in Authentik, unmanaged
    - attribute "nested" has an object or null value, which this operator cannot own per key; left in Authentik, unmanaged
    - attribute "settings" is reserved for Authentik or this operator; left in Authentik, unmanaged
    - parents ["p"] and roles ["r"] are not converted; they stay as they are in Authentik, unmanaged
    - members are not managed: JeffResc never managed membership, so spec.members is absent

Adoption gate: these objects use the operator's default connection, where Adopt is refused
(reason AdoptionNotAllowed) unless the operator admin allows their namespaces. Set the flag
--default-connection-adoption-namespace-selector, or the Helm value
adoption.defaultConnectionNamespaceSelector, to:
  kubernetes.io/metadata.name in (media)

Identity gate: groups on the default connection are refused (reason IdentityNotAllowed)
unless the operator admin allows their namespaces with
--default-connection-identity-namespace-selector, or the Helm value
identity.defaultConnectionNamespaceSelector, set to:
  kubernetes.io/metadata.name in (media)

Adopt mode: a missing group is reported as AdoptionTargetNotFound and nothing is created.
Once every group is migrated, leave adopt mode: remove managementPolicy and dryRun from
every converted group (final runbook step in docs/migration-from-jeffresc.md).
